name: Interspace DC MK-SK-1 (Interspace Skopje data center, Jane Sandanski)
notes: Operator page (A) confirms carrier-neutral colocation DCs in Skopje with ISO 27001/20000-1/22301 etc.; directory identifies DC MK-SK-1 at Blvd Jane Sandanski 109 (Aerodrom municipality per methodology street mapping) and lists 5 MW (directory figure, unverified, low confidence); Interspace also states a geographically separated DR data center ~100 km from Skopje whose location is not publicly named. why_this_is_a_data_center: marketed colocation data centre with redundant power/cooling, HSSD fire protection, 24/7 security. what_is_not_confirmed: exact municipal permit, MW, DR-site location.
